from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,sys,traceback

root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"control/codex_supervisor"))
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"control/jobs"))

import full_a2z_governed_v4 as a2z
import experiment_gate as gate

model_task="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-POSTBUILD-20261006-R3-P2"
src=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees/DEV-PRED-A2Z-POSTBUILD-RETRY-20261006-E106/knowledge/evidence/qualification/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4-GOVERNED"
dst=root/"knowledge/evidence/qualification/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4-GOVERNED"

if not src.exists():
    print("E114=SOURCE_BUNDLE_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(38)
if dst.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(dst)
shutil.copytree(src,dst)

overlay=json.loads((dst/"overlay.json").read_text())
mr=a2z.RUNTIME/"model_results"/f"{model_task}.json"
if not mr.exists():
    print("E114=MODEL_RESULT_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(40)

codes=[
 ("MODEL_PROVENANCE_MISSING_OR_REVOKED",42),
 ("MODEL_PHASE_OR_POLICY",43),
 ("MODEL_CONTEXT_MISMATCH",44),
 ("EXACT_MODEL_REQUIRED",45),
 ("MODEL_COMMAND_MISMATCH",46),
 ("MODEL_COMPLETION_BINDING",47),
 ("MODEL_EXECUTION_TOOL_FORBIDDEN",48),
 ("MODEL_TRANSCRIPT_NOT_COMPLETE",49),
 ("MODEL_TIME_ORDER",50),
 ("REVIEW_ACTUAL_INPUT_MISMATCH",51),
 ("REVIEW_COMPLETION_CONTENT_MISMATCH",52),
 ("REVIEW_COMPLETION_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH",53),
 ("POSTBUILD_REVIEW_BEFORE_BUILD",54),
 ("ASTRA_REVIEW_PHASE",55),
 ("ASTRA_REVIEW_CANDIDATE",56),
 ("ASTRA_REVIEW_WRONG_MODEL",57),
 ("ASTRA_REVIEW_STALE_BINDING",58),
 ("ASTRA_REVIEW_PROVENANCE",59),
 ("ASTRA_GOVERNED_PROVENANCE_INVALID",60),
 ("ASTRA_AUTONOMOUS_PROVENANCE",61),
 ("NO_TEST_OR_MEASUREMENT_BEFORE_ASTRA_POSTBUILD_APPROVAL",62),
]
try:
    review=a2z.import_review(dst,overlay,"POSTBUILD",model_task)
    a2z.save(dst/"overlay.json",overlay)
    checked,ref=gate.require_postbuild(dst,overlay)
    assert checked["decision"]=="APPROVE"
    assert review["decision"]=="APPROVE"
    print("E114=CANONICAL_POSTBUILD_IMPORT_PASS",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0)
except SystemExit:
    raise
except Exception as exc:
    msg=type(exc).__name__+":"+str(exc)
    print("E114_ERROR="+msg[:1200],flush=True)
    for needle,rc in codes:
        if needle in msg:
            print("E114="+needle,flush=True); raise SystemExit(rc)
    print("E114=UNMAPPED_IMPORT_FAILURE",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(69)
